runs.name: accessory_persistence
runs.asked_for: the device is identity and the case is styling: swapping a case is a visible change a person calls the same object, swapping the device is a different person. this is the corpus behind the accessory rule.

runs.name: jewelry_drift
runs.asked_for: silver for gold, a stone appearing, or the same piece on a different body part are changes; rewording the metal is not.

runs.name: hairstyle_drift
runs.asked_for: her own hair does not change between photographs, so a moved length, cut, parting or texture is not the same hairstyle however smoothly it is reworded.

runs.name: outfit_series
runs.asked_for: a whole outfit re-told, with substitutions of garment, fabric or colour labelled as the drift they are.
